Questions.Question: How many places in the main squad list are reserved for locally trained players, and how many of those can be association-trained?
Questions.Answer: According to the regulations, at least 8 places in the main squad list (List A) are reserved for locally trained players. Out of these, a maximum of 4 can be association-trained players (paragraphs 31.04 and 31.07).

Questions.Question: What are the age and tenure conditions for putting a young player on List B?
Questions.Answer: According to the UEFA Champions League regulations, a player may be listed on List B if they were born on or after 1 January 2002 and have been eligible to play for the club concerned for any uninterrupted period of two years since their 15th birthday. Players aged 16 may also be included if they have been registered with the club for the previous two years without interruption.

Questions.Question: If a club only has six locally trained players available, what happens to the size of its squad?
Questions.Answer: According to paragraph 31.04, if a club has fewer than eight locally trained players (comprising a maximum of four club-trained and four association-trained players), the maximum squad size is reduced accordingly. For a club with only six locally trained players, the total squad size would be reduced by two, resulting in a maximum size of 23 players instead of 25.

Questions.Question: Does Liverpool's registered squad satisfy the locally trained player requirement?
Questions.Answer: Liverpool's registered squad does not satisfy the locally trained player requirement because the total number of locally trained players (both club-trained and association-trained) is 5, which is less than the minimum requirement of 8 locally trained players as per regulation 31.08.

Questions.Question: Manchester United are short on club-trained players. How many can they actually register on List A as things stand?
Questions.Answer: Manchester United currently have 3 club-trained players available, but Article 42.04 of the UEFA Champions League regulations requires a minimum of 4 club-trained players on List A. If the club has fewer than 4 club-trained players, the corresponding shortfall reduces List A’s total size below the standard limit of 25 players. Thus, Manchester United can register a maximum of 24 players on List A as things stand.

Questions.Question: Real Madrid have registered the goalkeepers shown in their squad. Are they compliant on that front?
Questions.Answer: Yes, Real Madrid are compliant on that front. According to the regulations, a club must register at least two goalkeepers on their squad list. Real Madrid have registered two goalkeepers (Thibaut Courtois and Andriy Lunin), satisfying this requirement.
